thread:
Lina (sales): Quick heads-upPOC with Meridian starts tomorrow. Dry run showed a few integration hiccups. Can we triage?
Ethan (presales): Noted. Failures: long SSE streams drop after ~30s, function call outputs use snake_case while their runtime expects camelCase, and our refresh flow fails against their IdP (missing signed assertion).
Ravi (eng): SSE: our SDK keepalive is 25s. Their edge proxy drops idle at 30s under load. Short fix: decrease keepalive to 8-10s. Add `CLIENT_KEEPALIVE_MS=10000`.
Lina (sales): Can we give them a patched example quickly?
Ravi (eng): Yes. Small patch to sample app + README snippet. Also will add `--port=0` fallback to avoid EADDRINUSE seen in dry run.
deploy-bot: deploy failure for `meridian-sample` -> EADDRINUSE:8080
Ethan (presales): About the tool outputstheir JSON schema validator rejects snake_case keys. Any compatibility layer?
Ravi (eng): We'll include a tiny normalizer util `toCamelCaseKeys()` in examples. It's non-invasive.
Lina (sales): SSO: they require signed assertions for refresh. Our connector currently uses a client_credentials refresh.
Ethan (presales): Error: `invalid_grant - missing_assertion`.
Ravi (eng): Two routes: (A) enable session-exchange endpoint that accepts signed assertions (needs pilot enablement + legal AUP), or (B) issue a short-lived delegated key for the connector (security OK for timeboxed pilots).
Lina (sales): Security will prefer (A). How quick?
Ravi (eng): ~24-48hrs after legal signs AUP; I'll open ticket `POC-1234-session-exchange`.
Ethan (presales): They also asked about KMS and IP allowlist for connector egress, and whether streaming increases cost.
Ravi (eng): KMS: customer-managed keys are on Private/Dedicated. For pilots we can do a wrapped-key handshake. IP allowlist: provide proxy tunnel or static egress IPs for Dedicated. Billing: streaming billed per emitted token same as non-streaming; function calls add a small per-call metadata fee. Offer: capped pilot spend and token-level telemetry for visibility.
Lina (sales): Action items: 1) Ravi to PR sample fixes (keepalive, key normalizer, port fallback); 2) I file legal AUP and ticket `POC-1234`; 3) Ethan to update runbook and pricing note; 4) infra to redeploy sample after PR.
Ravi (eng): Draft PR `pr/451-poc-meridian-fixes` will include snippets and tests. I'll ping when merged.
Lina (sales): Thanks team ":thumbsup:" Will DM customer SRE after PR lands.
Ethan (presales): I'll add a short troubleshooting checklist to the presales runbook (heartbeat, normalize util, SSO options, port conflicts).
Lina (sales): End.
